payload.instruction: Change the image into pencil drawing
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the edited image, considered as a whole, visibly read as a pencil drawing of its content rather than an image with only limited pencil-style treatment?
node.criteria: Pass if the edited image as a whole is visibly rendered in a pencil-drawing style. Fail if sufficient evidence shows that the image retains a predominantly non-drawing appearance and only limited areas or details have pencil-style treatment. Unknown if the overall style or extent of treatment cannot be assessed reliably. Do not require any particular pencil technique, monochrome rendering, or method of transformation.
node.binding: Inspect source and edited images directly. Use the ancestor's observation of possible progress as context, then independently assess whether the edited image as a whole reads as a pencil drawing. Judge the visible result, not the method or specific marks used.

dependencies.evidence: The edited image shows a visible pencil-drawing-style treatment across the scene: colors are muted and surfaces have a grainy, sketch-like appearance with softened outlines. This is evidence of progress toward the requested style.
